secondary_effects: crude intake falls; every downstream unit starves within days
notes: Nameplate capacity is CDU capacity. A CDU outage is the only one that maps one to one onto plant kb/d.

secondary_effects: less feed for FCC and hydrocracker; more residue sold as fuel oil
notes: Rarely reported alone. Usually part of a CDU train.

secondary_effects: propylene and LPG fall; VGO backs up; alkylation feed falls
notes: The single most important unit for gasoline. An FCC outage with the CDU running usually means the plant cuts crude rates within a week.

secondary_effects: naphtha yield falls; VGO backs up
notes: The single most important unit for middle distillates. Watch for this one in Europe and Asia.

secondary_effects: more residue sold as fuel oil; coke output stops; crude slate shifts lighter
notes: A coker outage lowers the value of heavy sour crude to that plant and raises HSFO supply.

secondary_effects: hydrogen production falls, which can limit hydrotreaters; naphtha demand falls
notes: Octane and hydrogen. A reformer outage can force hydrotreater cuts via hydrogen shortage.

secondary_effects: high sulphur distillate supply rises; ULSD supply falls
notes: On-spec diesel is the product. The crude keeps running but the barrel cannot be sold as ULSD.

secondary_effects: reformer feed falls if NHT is down
notes: NHT down usually takes the reformer down with it.

secondary_effects: isobutane and olefins build; blending octane tighter
notes: Small volume, large octane effect. Matters more in the US summer gasoline season.

secondary_effects: hydrotreaters and hydrocracker must cut rates to limit H2S; plant may cut crude on sour slate
notes: No product of its own but an SRU outage is a frequent cause of plant-wide rate cuts on sour crude. Common in TCEQ reports.
Same logic as SRU. Hydrogen is the limiting input for clean fuels.

secondary_effects: whole plant trips; restart takes 3 to 10 days even if units are undamaged
notes: Weather and grid events. Most Gulf Coast hurricane and freeze outages are this.

secondary_effects: FCC feed quality falls; more high sulphur fuel oil; FCC may cut rates
notes: Added after golden set g010. Pre-treats residue for the FCC. Not a diesel hydrotreater; the product hit is indirect via gasoline.
